## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### Through an API

api (fal.ai) · $0.010/image · [fal.ai](https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/ernie-image/turbo)

<sub>[price source](https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/ernie-image/turbo): USD for one 1-megapixel output: fal bills this endpoint $0.01 per output megapixel (price = rate × 1 MP; fal's rounding for 1024×1024 ≈ 1.05 MP is not stated; larger outputs cost proportionally more). Product: fal.ai serverless text-to-image (Turbo, 8 steps default). API model: fal-ai/ernie-image/turbo. Settings: 1 MP output, num\_images=1. Price basis: published per-megapixel list rate × 1 MP. Currency: USD. Not a Baidu direct tariff. fal.ai official model page, observed 2026-09-25.</sub>

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (gguf-ud-q4_k_m + Ministral 3B (sd.cpp), needs ~17.1 GB, from [github.com/leejet](https://github.com/leejet/stable-diffusion.cpp/blob/3f8527a46c54ecf4cb4ed6003da8e8982283c73c/docs/ernie_image.md))
   
   ```sh
   sd-cli --diffusion-model models/ernie-image-turbo-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf --vae models/flux2_ae.safetensors --llm models/ministral-3-3b.safetensors -p "a lovely cat" --cfg-scale 1.0 --steps 8 -v --offload-to-cpu --diffusion-fa
   ```

Other versions: BF16 (~19.7 GB, NVIDIA only) `uv run --with git+https://github.com/huggingface/diffusers --with transformers --with accelerate --with torch --with sentencepiece python -c "import torch; from diffusers import ErnieImagePipeline; p=ErnieImagePipeline.from_pretrained('baidu/ERNIE-Image-Turbo', torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16).to('cuda'); p(prompt='a cat holding a sign', height=1024, width=1024, num_inference_steps=8, guidance_scale=1.0).images[0].save('out.png')"` · BF16 + MINISTRAL 3B (SD.CPP) (~29.4 GB) `sd-cli --diffusion-model models/ernie-image-turbo.safetensors --vae models/flux2_ae.safetensors --llm models/ministral-3-3b.safetensors -p "a lovely cat" --cfg-scale 1.0 --steps 8 -v --offload-to-cpu --diffusion-fa`

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/baidu](https://huggingface.co/baidu/ERNIE-Image-Turbo)
